svg.title: Brooklyn Neighborhoods
svg.desc: Chris Whong / NYC Neighborhood Boundaries contributors, derived from Zillow (2017); commit a14c924b16ce659d034ab15a8f45229b05a1f1f5. CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Borough extraction, duplicate merging, nonresidential context classification, overlap partition (smaller sub-neighborhoods first), shared-edge noding, projection, rounding, SVG and thumbnail conversion. Derived NYC map assets are CC BY-SA 4.0. Approximate colloquial boundaries, not official districts. Sub-neighborhoods take precedence over overlapping parent neighborhoods; the parent label applies to its remaining area. Parks start green; other nonresidential areas are muted context. Every playable area is distinct. Derived map licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
